Dr Sarawut is a great dentist who cares about what is best for you and not what make him the most money. Prior to a trip to Phuket I went to a dentist in Brisbane and was told I needed a root canal and that the tooth could not be saved so I would need to implant/crown. I decided to wait and see what it would cost in Thailand. I made the rounds of several dentists and chose Dr Sarawut even though he was not the cheapest. When he examined my tooth he confirmed that a root canal was necessary but that he would be able to save the tooth, "you do not get rid of your own teeth unless there is no alternative" he said. I was impressed. On my last visit I had a cavity on the side of a wisdom tooth that was right at the gum line so could not be filled. Dr Sarawut told that the tooth would need to come out but told me wait and do it back in Australia, he said "you are on holiday so you do not want to ruin that with getting a wisdom tooth extracted."  Again, more concerned with what was best for me than making money. When I did get it removed back in Brisbane I understood what he meant and was thankful for his advise.
I am going back next month to have my amalgam fillings replaced. By the time I included the cost of airfare and accommodation I will probably be paying close to the same as I would in Brisbane but Dr Sarawut is worth it. If you are visiting Phuket and want/need to get dental work done then do yourself a favour book an appointment with Dr Sarawut.
